taskee_principles.title: Taskee Principles
taskee_principles.subtitle: The values that guide how taskees should conduct themselves on BitTasker.
taskee_principles.heading: Our Taskee Principles
taskee_principles.description: These principles guide how taskees should conduct themselves on BitTasker. They represent the values that make our platform trustworthy and beneficial for both taskers and taskees.

1.title: 1. Deliver Excellence
1.text: Complete every task to the highest possible standard. Your reputation depends on consistent quality work.

2.title: 2. Communicate Clearly
2.text: Keep taskers informed about progress, potential issues, and any changes to the agreed scope.

3.title: 3. Be Reliable
3.text: Honor your commitments and meet deadlines. If issues arise, communicate early and work toward solutions.

4.title: 4. Respect Privacy
4.text: Protect confidential information and respect the privacy of taskers and their business.

5.title: 5. Be Professional
5.text: Maintain professional conduct in all interactions and work with integrity.
